description:
Lists monitored website properties in the Paperloo compliance registry with status filtering ('all', 'active', 'compliant', 'needs_audit') and offset/limit pagination, returning summary compliance grades, banner readiness, GTM state, and document counts.

When to use vs. related tools: Call 'list_sites' to discover valid 'siteId' identifiers before calling site-specific tools ('get_site', 'configure_cookie_banner', 'configure_gtm_integration', 'export_documents', 'delete_site'). Call 'get_site' afterward if you need a site's full nested cookie_banner, gtm, and document Markdown contents.

Preconditions & side effects: No required parameters. Read-only registry query.

Returns: JSON object with 'success', 'total_count', 'returned_count', 'offset', 'limit', 'filter_applied', and 'sites' array (or 'error' + 'supported_filters' if invalid filter/pagination arguments are supplied).

limit.description: Maximum number of site summaries returned per page (1-100).

offset.description: Zero-based pagination offset into the filtered list.

name: list_sites

outputSchema.description: Paginated list of monitored sites in the registry.

error.description: Validation error message when success is false.

returned_count.description: Number of sites included in the current page.

sites.description: Summary entries for monitored sites matching the filter.

cookie_banner_active.description: Whether a cookie consent banner configuration is attached.

gtm_configured.description: Whether a non-pending GTM container ID is bound.

jurisdictions.description: Regulatory frameworks enforced for the site.

name.description: Display name of the monitored site.

success.description: True if registry listing succeeded; false if filter/pagination arguments are invalid.

supported_filters.description: Valid filter values returned when an unsupported filter is supplied.

total_count.description: Total matching sites prior to offset/limit slicing.

title: List Monitored Websites
